data.description: Alpine Saxon Woods, based in Harrison, N.Y., declared today its inclusion in the prestigious PSN Top Guns List for top-performing managed account strategies in Q2 of 2026. This list, released by YCharts, is a significant benchmark for the industry.

data.title: SDK.finance Announces Expanded Platform Focus to Power Native Financial Products for Retailers, Marketplaces, and Telecoms
data.description: In Vilnius, Lithuania, on September 18, 2026, SDK.finance revealed its plan to broaden its core platform reach to cater to non-financial consumer brands. Specializing in software solutions for modern wallets and payments, the company aims to diversify its offerings to target a new market segment. This strategic expansion underscores SDK.finance's commitment to innovation and growth.

data.title: NorCal Auto Group Deepens Support for Hyundai Hope on Wheels with $100,000 for UC Davis Comprehensive Cancer Center
data.description: Potamkin Hyundai dealerships in the Sacramento region, operated by NorCal Auto Group, a subsidiary of Potamkin Automotive Group, have donated over $4 million to the program since 1998. This significant contribution highlights their ongoing commitment to supporting the community.

data.title: In HelloNation, Real Estate Experts Anita Sherley & Cassi Krei Share Guidance for Veterans Relocating to Helena, MT
data.description: In a recent article by HelloNation, the advantages of veterans relocating to Helena, Montana are discussed. Anita Sherley and Cassi Krei from Sherley Real Estate provide insights on this topic. The piece delves into various ways veterans can benefit from moving to Helena, Montana, such as access to specialized services, a supportive community, and potential career opportunities. This article aims to guide veterans in making informed decisions about relocating, with Helena offering unique advantages for those who have served in the military.

data.title: General Lester Lyles Receives 2026 Lifetime Achievement Award from the Air & Space Forces Association
data.description: In Washington on September 18, 2026, General Lester Lyles, who serves as the Chair of the Board of Trustees for the Universities Space Research Association, was honored with the 2026 AFA Lifetime Achievement Award from the Air & Space Forces Association. This award acknowledges his notable career and contributions to the field.

data.title: Germany, Lockheed Martin Celebrate Rollout of Germany's First F-35A, Marking New Era of German Airpower
data.description: During a ceremony held on September 18, 2026, in Fort Worth, Texas, Lockheed Martin officially handed over Germany's inaugural F-35A Lightning II to the German government. The event marked a significant milestone in the partnership between the two countries, with the aircraft being the first of its kind to be delivered to Germany. The presentation took place at Lockheed Martin's facility, with the aircraft being a part of the F-35 family produced by the company. The F-35A Lightning II is a state-of-the-art aircraft known for its advanced capabilities and cutting-edge technology. This delivery signifies a new era in Germany's air defense capabilities, as the country now possesses a world-class fighter jet to enhance its national security.

data.title: ASI Names Former Zillow Product Leader Matt Gilliland Chief Product Officer
data.description: In Trevose, Pennsylvania, on September 18, 2026, the Advertising Specialty Institute® (ASI) revealed that Matt Gilliland has taken on the role of chief product officer since September 14. ASI is a key technology provider in the promotional products sector which is valued at $27.7 billion. Gilliland's appointment is expected to fuel the company's growth in this sector.

data.title: BCB Bancorp, Inc. Announces Closing of Public Offering and Full Exercise of Underwriter’s Over-Allotment Option, for Aggregate Gross Proceeds of $98 Million
data.description: A financial institution based in Bayonne, New Jersey, BCB Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: BCBP), revealed the successful completion of its recent underwritten public offering on September 18, 2026. The company, serving as the holding entity for BCB Community Bank, finalized the sale of 12,650,000 shares of its common stock. This figure includes an additional 1,650,000 shares exercised by the underwriters, priced at $7.75 per share for the public offering. The total gross proceeds generated amounted to roughly $98,037,500. After accounting for underwriting discounts, commissions, and estimated offering expenses, the net amount collected by the company stands as the significant financial outcome of this recently concluded public offering.

data.title: Ramps Logistics CEO Joins Global Tariffs Panel at Breakbulk Americas 2026 as Trinidad-Developed AI Platform Returns
data.description: Trinidad and Tobago's Ramps Logistics CEO, Shaun Rampersad, will participate at Breakbulk Americas 2026 in Houston, the biggest event in the Americas. The event is scheduled for September 22–23 at the George R. Brown Convention Center. On September 23, Rampersad will join the discussion titled "Planning in the Fog: Risk, Tariffs, and the Cost of Resilience" on the Breakbulk Live Stage, where international trade and project cargo experts will share insights. It promises to be an engaging session focusing on crucial industry topics.
